title: Tornado
tldr: If a tornado warning covers your location, shelter now in a basement or small interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Stay away from windows and cover your head and neck. A mobile home is not a safe tornado shelter.
steps: Move immediately; put shoes on if within reach and take your phone without delaying. Use a designated storm shelter when accessible.
Crouch low and cover your head and neck with your arms. Use a sturdy table or available cushioning for additional protection.
If outside or in a vehicle
Get to a nearby sturdy building if safely possible. Do not shelter under an overpass. Vehicles and mobile homes offer little protection.
Use local warning messages or weather radio; remain sheltered until the threat has passed and official updates permit leaving.
next: Afterward, avoid damaged buildings, broken glass and downed lines. Check for injuries and use text to let your contact know you are safe.
watch: Do not wait to see a funnel. Darkness and rain can hide tornadoes. A watch calls for readiness; a warning calls for action.
